c_meta.note: Panel markets (SPX, RUT, TSX, HSI) use panel returns on the US calendar; DAX, N225, IXIC (and an HSI own-calendar robustness row) use Yahoo closes on their own calendars. Off-leg IEF and gold are the panel sleeves mapped as-of onto each calendar; before 1985-10-02 IEF is rebuilt from ^TNX with the panel's own calibration and gold is replaced by T-bills (gold is a constant 15% in every book, so it cannot favour a weekday). rf = panel rf (^IRX before 1985-10-02). The 2x sleeve is 2r - 0.95%/252 - rf_d on every market.

E3_date_alignment_and_autocorr.note: corr(ndx_t, other_{t+k}); a 1-day timestamp shift would put the peak at k=+-1 instead of 0
